teamAi.stage.notOperatorLine: The server operator adds the team AI key.
teamAi.stage.notOperatorDetail: Once the operator adds a key under Settings › AI, you can turn the helper on. You can skip this for now.
teamAi.stage.loadErrorLine: Could not check the team AI connection.
teamAi.stage.loadErrorDetail: Check your connection and try again, or set this up later under Settings › AI.
teamAi.stage.keyDetail: With a key, a helper in chat answers questions and raises changes as approval cards. If you skip, the helper stays off.
teamAi.stage.setupLine: Name the helper and choose what it does.
teamAi.stage.setupDetail: The key is connected. You can change these later under Settings › AI.
teamAi.stage.setupUnverifiedDetail: This server does not check the key directly. You will know it works when the helper first answers.
teamAi.stage.enableFailedLine: Could not turn the helper on.
teamAi.stage.enableFailedDetail: Your key is saved. Try again, or skip and turn it on later under Settings › AI.
teamAi.stage.doneDetail: Mention it with @ in chat to try it.
teamAi.stage.renameFailedNote: The name was not changed. Try again under Settings › AI.
teamAi.stage.reentry: You can skip. Add a key and turn the helper on any time under Settings › AI.
teamAi.stage.offline: You are offline, so the helper cannot be turned on now. You can continue once you reconnect.
teamAi.helper.description: Set the helper name and what it can do.
teamAi.helper.nameHint: You can call it by the new name too. Earlier call names stay, and past 4 the oldest ones drop off.
teamAi.helper.aliasNotDerivable: This name cannot become a short call name. In chat, type @ and the full name.
teamAi.helper.aliasReserved: This name cannot be used as a call name.
teamAi.helper.nameErrorTaken: Another member uses this name or one that looks too similar. Try a different name.
teamAi.helper.nameErrorReserved: This name cannot be used in mentions. Try a different name.
teamAi.helper.nameErrorInvalid: The name cannot be empty or longer than 100 characters.
teamAi.helper.nameErrorForbidden: Only an owner or admin can change the name.
teamAi.helper.nameErrorOther: Could not change the name. Check your connection and try again.
teamAi.helper.rolesHint: When off, the helper does not do that. Only admins turn these on or off.
teamAi.helper.rolesOffline: You are offline, so this cannot be changed now.
teamAi.helper.rolesSaveFailed: Could not change what the helper does. Check your connection and try again.
teamAi.helper.rolesMemoryOff: Team memory is off. Turn it on first under Settings › Memory.
teamAi.helper.rolesForbidden: Only an owner or admin can change what the helper does.
teamAi.roles.chatReadHint: Answers questions, reads the chats and members the caller can see, and searches the web.
teamAi.roles.workspaceAdminHint: Raises approval cards to create channels, change profiles and names, and change settings or install apps.
teamAi.roles.inviteAccessHint: Raises approval cards to create invite links and invite agents.
teamAi.roles.longResearchHint: Keeps working on research that takes a while.
teamAi.roles.memoryHint: Searches team memory and suggests things worth remembering.
teamAi.roles.codeHint: Prefills a work request card for code tasks. The helper does not run code itself.
teamAi.roles.noticeFiles: Turning on Files sends the content of attachments the helper reads to your team AI provider (the AI company that issued the team key).
teamAi.roles.noticeMemory: Turning on Memory sends the content of team memory the helper finds to your team AI provider (the AI company that issued the team key).
teamAi.roles.noticeBoth: Turning on Files and Memory sends the content of attachments the helper reads and team memory it finds to your team AI provider (the AI company that issued the team key).
